note: v2 prompts (capability eval redesign, 2026-10-29): real = AgiBot's caption; object / action / direction = alternatives written from the context frame that use only verbs and direction words that occur in training: object = a trained verb on another object visible in the frame, action = another trained verb that the scene allows, direction = a trained verb moved in another direction. No prompt names an arm. Exposure per prompt: results/capeval/prompt_ladder_v2.json (scripts/capeval/tag_prompts.py). Capability eval cases. Every case is a REAL AgiBot World Beta episode that training never saw: either in no split of Jinyan0924/agibot-flux3-eval-splits (never sampled, never fetched; split 'unsampled') or a test_unseen episode of one of the 5 held-out tasks. anchor = segment start + 2, so the k = 1 context frame is the segment's first frame. real = AgiBot's annotation (verbatim, may name an arm); alt1 = same action reworded, no arm; alt2 = a different action in the same scene (no ground truth). Prompts written by Claude (LLM) from the segment's frames. A case with "source": "generated" would carry an edited context_image instead (none so far).
